checks: CreateDoc uses authenticated same-origin requests and reuses a call_id after failure for the same title; double submit is guarded.
Document list shows authenticated API records, empty state, and loading failure without demonstration fallback.
Editor retains per-user drafts, tracks body/title/version base after successful merge, persists title with expected_version, and detects competing title changes.
Saving is guarded against overlapping saves and edits; failed title writes retain merged body and the pending title for retry.
Legacy drafts lacking version base are copied into a separate recovery record with Markdown export, avoiding automatic stale-body merge.
Recovery storage failures preserve the original draft by blocking overwrite/removal; successful server saves distinguish synced state from local draft state.
verification_limits: This agent performed source review only and did not independently execute browser scenarios.
Root reported real-browser create/edit/refresh and second save/refresh success; those are root-owned evidence and are not claimed as reviewer executions.
Title and body use separate version-checked requests, so a title failure can leave body already persisted; UI preserves title for retry.

byte_normalization.change: CRLF to LF only after independent review; hashes refreshed for exact Git bytes
